subject: general
question:
'X is the mother of Y' is represented by 'X 

'X is the husband of Y' is represented by 'X > Y'

'X is the sister of Y' is represented by 'X @ Y' 

'X is the son of Y' is represented by 'X $ Y' 

Which of the following indicates the relationship 'R is the daughter of Q'?
solution:
X is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
$

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
mother

 
 
 
husband

 
 
 
sister

 
 
 
son

 
 
 

 
 
to Y

 
 
 

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94d2b18c1c3c379079396b072d63e200b53fdc1831ac7079ffc1993c62593246.png] 

 
• R @ H > K → R is sister of H, H is husband of K, K is mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1388dfcb09b23b924e9457a0c69c71dd39fc96d213d4a3719d54c462da29eb.png] 

⇒ R is the aunt of Q.

 
• **R @ H $ K > Q **→ R is sister of H, H is son of K, K is husband of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/900f4044ca247ff245f715cc287906b062116dfd7ec5b66da25bfec6889143a3.png] 

**⇒ R is the daughter of Q.**

 
• Q > K @ R $ H → Q is husband of K, K is sister of R, R is son of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27e7acea3134f830be18c5bb35e3936c9f458f5741b7df1d921b58f7fe7186b3.png] 

⇒ R is the brother-in-law of Q.

 
• Q → Q is mother of K, K is sister of H, H is son of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d38ef35f62ab6f849903fdc5b9399b66f2953f5758d8f09d2d58fff0cc73e41.png] 

⇒ R is the husband of Q.

Clearly, R @ H $ K > Q indicates the relationship 'R is the daughter of Q'.

Hence, '**R @ H $ K > Q**' is the correct answer.
